title: Boss Battle: Launch Day!
description: It's your first day managing performance ads for 'FitZone Gym'. You have ₹15,000 to acquire new members. Make the right strategic decisions across 6 critical steps to defeat the Boss and graduate to Operator status!

steps.title: Step 1: Choose the Campaign Objective
steps.context: FitZone wants local residents to book a free personal training trial session and tour the facility.
steps.question: Which Meta campaign objective will you select?
options: Awareness (Reach as many screens as cheaply as possible)
Traffic (Get maximum link clicks to the homepage)
Leads (Collect contact info via Instant Form or WhatsApp)
App Promotion (Drive gym workout app downloads)
steps.explain: For service businesses, the 'Leads' objective optimizes for prospects ready to submit their contact info or message to book a trial.
steps.hint: What is the concrete action you want the gym visitor to take?

steps.title: Step 2: Define Audience Targeting
steps.context: FitZone is located in Koramangala, Bengaluru. People will not travel 25 km across city traffic to work out.
steps.question: Which audience setup should you choose?
options: All adults aged 18-65 across entire state of Karnataka
Adults aged 21-45 living within a 5 km radius of the gym, interested in Fitness or Broad
Only people interested in Olympic powerlifting aged 18-20 (Audience size: 4,000)
Anyone in India who has ever visited a sports stadium
steps.explain: Gyms are hyper-local. A 5 km radius targeting active adults gives a balanced pool of realistic gym-goers.
steps.hint: Local gyms depend on people who live or work nearby.

steps.title: Step 3: Budget Configuration
steps.context: Your target Cost Per Trial Booking (CPL) is ₹100. You have ₹15,000 total for the month.
steps.question: How should you pace your starting daily budget?
options: ₹50 per day (so the money lasts 300 days)
₹500 per day (5x target CPL, giving the algorithm enough daily conversion data to learn)
Spend all ₹15,000 on Saturday between 2 PM and 4 PM
₹10 per day on 50 different campaigns
steps.explain: A ₹500 daily budget (5x target CPL) gives Meta's algorithm enough room to capture 4-5 leads daily and optimize smoothly.
steps.hint: Remember the 3x-5x target CPL rule of thumb.

steps.title: Step 4: Select the Winning Creative
steps.context: You have 4 creative options ready to test. Which visual will grab the highest engagement?
steps.question: Which visual and hook will drive the highest engagement and trial bookings?
options: Stock photo of a fitness model from California with a lengthy paragraph about health
Gym brand logo with operating hours in tiny font
15-second mobile Reel: Member's real 3-month weight loss transformation + 'Claim Free 3-Day Pass' headline
Black and white flyer listing 20 gym rules
steps.explain: Real member transformations with clear local social proof and an irresistible free trial hook always outperform generic stock photos.
steps.hint: What stops you when you scroll Instagram Reels?

steps.title: Step 5: Reading Day 3 Results
steps.context: It's morning of Day 3. Here is your dashboard table:
steps.question: How do you evaluate these Day 3 numbers?
options: Disaster! Pause the campaign immediately.
Healthy performance! CTR is strong (2.2%) and CPL is ₹93.75 (beating our ₹100 target).
CPM is too low, so the ad must be broken.
Change the video hook right now to see if we can get 50% CTR.
steps.explain: All key indicators are green: CTR is high, CPM is competitive, and you have beat your CPL goal with 16 booked trials!
steps.hint: Compare actual CPL with the target CPL.

steps.title: Step 6: The Strategic Move
steps.context: Your client calls you excited about the 16 leads, but says: 'Can we triple the daily budget right now to ₹3,000/day?'
steps.question: What is the correct recommendation to give the gym owner?
options: Agree and immediately increase budget by 500% in one click.
Advise against an instant 500% jump because it resets learning. Recommend scaling vertically by 20% every 2-3 days while monitoring lead quality.
Turn off the campaign and tell the gym to rely on organic flyers.
Delete the ad and start an awareness campaign.
steps.explain: Tripling budget resets Meta's machine learning and often causes CPL to explode. Scale smoothly in 15-20% increments.
steps.hint: What happens to the auction algorithm if you shock it with a huge sudden budget change?
